ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course will introduce students to the range of horticultural crops and ecosystems common in Puerto Rico and elsewhere in the Caribbean. The course will meet on-line every Monday evening (except November 19,2012) and culminate in field study in Puerto Rico from January 12-20, 2013. An additional $1500 fee will be charged for lodging, surface transportation, etc. Contact Dr. Endress for additional information:217-244-1679 or aendress@illinois.edu. Instructor approval is required to enroll in this course. Online scheduled class sessions require each student to have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Wireless internet is not recommended.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: ACES Field Trip $1500.00 Flat Fee, Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
